description: This file implements performance metrics tracing classes for plugin activation, deactivation, and resource usage logging within the WPEFramework plugin system. It defines classes for internal metrics and browser metrics logging, including enabling/disabling, activation, suspension, and page load events.

classes.name: Metric
classes.description: A class for internal metric data representation, holding formatted text and providing data and length accessors.

classes.name: MetricsTraceOuput
classes.description: Implements IStateMetricsLogger for plugin state metrics, handling enable/disable, activation, suspension, and deactivation events.

classes.name: MetricsTraceOuputBrowser
classes.description: Implements IBrowserMetricsLogger for browser-specific metrics, including page load and visibility events.

methods.name: PerformanceMetrics::LoggerFactory
methods.description: Template method to create logger instances for different metrics interfaces.
